name: animated-theme-toggler
title: Theme Toggler
description: A light / dark toggle that reveals the new theme with a View Transition, as a circle, polygon or star growing from the button.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the reveal in milliseconds.

props.name: fromCenter
props.description: Grow the reveal from the centre of the viewport instead of from the button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme (e.g. from next-themes). When set, the component does not write to localStorage; pair it with onThemeChange.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Called on every toggle with the new theme.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Any other button attribute. A custom onClick runs first; call event.preventDefault() to skip the toggle.
